question: Under what condition must a particular teaching be concealed with effort in the mortal world among the lowest of men rather than openly disclosed?
premises: A teaching of this kind carries an obligation to be concealed.
Such concealment is to be carried out with deliberate effort.
The proper sphere for such concealment is the mortal world among the lowest of men.
inference: The transmission of this teaching is restricted by the unfit character of its audience.
uncertainties: The precise teaching to be concealed is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: This teaching must be concealed with effort in the mortal world, among the lowest of men.
